CVE-2026-15059.title: systemd: systemd-oomd: Unprivileged users can terminate arbitrary processes via IPC API
CVE-2026-15059.description: A flaw was found in systemd-oomd. Local unprivileged users can exploit a missing path traversal validation in the systemd-oomd Inter-Process Communication (IPC) Application Programming Interface (API). This vulnerability allows them to terminate arbitrary local processes, leading to a denial of service.
